title: Pour Sheets producer record
description: producers/<id>/producer.json. Facts about the producer that every vintage and wine from it shares. Claims go in producers/<id>/sources.md.

name.description: As the sheet prints it, such as Domaine Gagnard-Delagrange.

also.description: Other names, such as the one CellarTracker uses.

region.description: A stable id from regions/tree.json: where the producer is based.

story.description: The sheet's story text, under 'The family', 'The house' or whatever the region profile calls it. Sourced in sources.md.

story_title.description: Optional. A heading for the story that differs from the region profile's, such as 'The family' for a grower in a region of houses.
